facility.name: Kimberly Yvette Bell
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Plan for Extreme Weather: The operational policies does not state the plan for physical activity when the weather prevent outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Plan for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §747.501(8)(C))

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation: The child care home is not documenting the following: fire drills, checks of the smoke and carbon monoxide detector and fire extinguisher.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Safety Drills Documentation (26 TAC §747.801(7))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: The sheet on a play yard being used by an infant was not fitting snugly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Of the four children's records evaluated, three arae behind with required immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: The primary caregiver received 28 of the 30 clock hours of required annual training. The caregiver will need to 2 clock hours of make-up training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: Of the four children's records evalauted, the parents have not been informed in writing that the operation does not have liability insurance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher has not been serviced since February 2024. The fire extinguisher must be serviced annually.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: The smoke detector in the home is not working,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)

occurrences.finding: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible: A can of disinfectant spray and Lyslol cleaner was accessible to children. The disinfectant spray was on a shelf and the Lysoil cleaner was stored in the cabinet underneath the bathroom sink.  This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Separate from Food and Inaccessible (26 TAC §747.3203(13))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The primary caregiver did not receive training in communicable diseases and immunizations for the August 2023-August 2024 training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment: A plank was missing from the privacy fence in the backyard which presented a risk to children. This was corrected at inspection. Pictures were taken.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sanitation of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §747.3203)

occurrences.finding: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification: The Consumer Product Certification form has not been completed within the last year. The last form was completed January 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Records Maintained and Made Available - Children's Product Certification (26 TAC §747.801(12))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline: The operational policies did not include information on how a parent may contact the local Child Care Regulation office, website and Texas Abuse Hotline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Instructions for Contacting Licensing Office/Online and TX Abuse & Neglect Hotline (26 TAC §747.501(11))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants: The operational policies does not include a Safe Sleep policy for children 0-12 months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours: The caregiver did not complete annual training hours in communicable diseases including immunizations, food allergies and understanding building and physical premises safety,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required Special Topics without specific hours (26 TAC §747.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports: The operational policies does not inform parents of how they view a copy of the Minimum Standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports (26 TAC §747.501(10))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: The diaper changing pad is torn; therefore, it's no longer non-absorbent and needs to be replaced.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §747.3303(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment: Parents have not been notified in writing that the childcare home does not have liabilaty insurance,
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parent Notification of Liability Insurance - If No Insurance Must Notify Parent in Writing at Enrollment (26 TAC §747.213(a))

occurrences.finding: Policies Comply with Rules: The operational policies is lacking the following information:  1. The safe sleep policy is not consistent with Minimum Standard requirements.  2. The requirement for outdoor and physical activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Policies Comply with Rules (26 TAC §747.207(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plan: The Emergency Preparedness Plan lacks the following information:  1. How children under the age of 2, children with limited mobility or disabilities will be evacuated.  2. A copy of the emergency evacuation and relocation diagram.  3. How parent contact and emergency contact information will be evacuated.  4. How authorization for emergency medical care forms will be evacuated.  5. How children will be cared for during the emergency.  6. How children will be reunited with their parent once the emergency is over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Emergency Preparedness Plan (26 TAC §747.501(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the four children's records evaluated, one was behind with immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §747.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Uncovered outlets were observed in the room used by children. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Of the four children's records evaluated, all lacked the address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §747.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: There was no emergency evacuation and relocation diagram available to review during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The operational policy was observed missing the required information on Promotion of indoor/outdoor physical activity.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §747.501(8))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Release Information: Two of the six children records observed were missing names and number of other contacts who the children can be release to.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Release Information (26 TAC §747.605(7))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: Cleaning products and hand sanitizer was observed accessible to children sitting on top of a low shelf. This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver was observed removing the products and placing them in a locked cabinet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §747.3203(14))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants: The operational policy reviewed did not include safe sleep policy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants (26 TAC §747.501(6))
